Public domain: every person whose words are in this text died in 1925 or earlier, so the term has ended under the law of every country, whichever one first published it.

People: Augustus Mayhew (author, Wikidata Q4821493), died 1875; Henry Mayhew (author, Wikidata Q1227273), died 1887; George Cruikshank (illustrator, Wikidata Q360466), died 1878. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Mayhew, Augustus, 1826-1875; Mayhew, Henry, 1812-1887; Cruikshank, George, 1792-1878 [Illustrator]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's (Wikidata gives some of them several death years, every one 1925 or earlier: George Cruikshank [1873, 1878]).

Printed edition: New sketches of every-day life: a diary. Together with Strife and peace. Translated [from the Swedish] by Mary Howitt, New York Harper, 1844, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/newsketchesofeve00bremuoft. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 90%, 94%, 93% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Augustus Mayhew, Henry Mayhew, George Cruikshank, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
